pitch.meaning: body pitch about the hip; positive tips the breast down

head.meaning: head rotation about the neck; positive cocks the beak down

headX.meaning: head offset along the body, for stabilisation

eye.meaning: below 0.75 the closed drawing (the generated half-lid reads as a black slab), else open

wingN.meaning: near wing rotation at the shoulder

wingF.meaning: far wing rotation at the shoulder

tail.meaning: tail rotation; negative flicks it up

tuck.meaning: 0 standing legs, 1 feet curled for flight
